description: This file defines delegates and interfaces related to grain call context management in Orleans, including interception points for incoming, outgoing, and general grain method invocations.

classes.name: IGrainCallContext
classes.description: Interface representing a method invocation context with properties and methods to access request details, response, and invocation mechanics.

classes.name: IIncomingGrainCallContext
classes.description: Interface extending IGrainCallContext for incoming calls, providing access to target context and implementation method.

classes.name: IOutgoingGrainCallContext
classes.description: Interface extending IGrainCallContext for outgoing calls, providing access to source context.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Method to invoke the request asynchronously.
